answer_prose: Finishes more than 2% faster than an earlier benchmark occurred in 56.6% of faster-second-20-km races, 55.9% of similar-block races, and 41.3% of moderately slowing races. These are observed associations, not proof that a particular split pattern causes success.
detail_prose: We compare equal 20 km blocks because no measured halfway checkpoint is available.
